pack.name: SOX IT General Controls Pack
pack.description: SOX Section 302/404 IT General Controls covering logical access, change management, computer operations, and data backup/recovery. Mapped to PCAOB AS 2201 control objectives.
pack.author: GovernexPlus
pack.changelog: Initial release — 15 SOX ITGC process controls

items.name: User Access Provisioning Control
items.description: Access to production systems is provisioned only upon management authorization. New access requests require documented business justification and manager approval before activation.

test_procedure: Select a sample of new user accounts created during the period
Obtain evidence of management authorization for each selected account
Verify that access provisioned matches the authorized access request
Confirm no access was granted prior to authorization
evidence_requirements: Access request ticket with manager approval
User account creation log with timestamp
payload.key_risk: Unauthorized system access leading to fraud or data breach

items.name: User Access Termination Control
items.description: Access is promptly revoked upon employee termination or role change. HR-triggered de-provisioning occurs within 24 hours of termination date. Periodic reviews identify orphaned accounts.

test_procedure: Obtain HR termination listing for the period
Compare termination dates to system account disable/delete dates
Identify any accounts not disabled within 24 hours of termination
Review access for transferred employees for timely role changes
payload.key_risk: Terminated employee retaining system access enabling unauthorized transactions

items.name: Privileged Access Review
items.description: Privileged and super-user access is reviewed quarterly. Basis and rationale for privileged access is re-justified by control owners. Unused privileged IDs are revoked.

test_procedure: Obtain listing of all privileged accounts (SAP_ALL, basis admins, DB admins)
Verify each privileged account has a documented and approved business justification
Confirm quarterly review was performed and approved by CISO or designee
Test that unused privileged accounts have been disabled
evidence_requirements: Evidence of remediation for removed accounts
payload.key_risk: Excessive privileged access enabling unauthorized changes or data extraction

items.name: Segregation of Duties Monitoring
items.description: Incompatible duties are identified and monitored via continuous SoD rule execution. Conflicts are reviewed and either mitigated or accepted with documented management approval.

test_procedure: Verify SoD ruleset covers key financial process conflicts (AP/AR, GL, payroll)
Review open SoD violations for timely remediation or documented risk acceptance
Confirm mitigating controls are operating effectively for accepted conflicts
Test that new access assignments trigger SoD conflict checks
evidence_requirements: SoD violation report with remediation status
Risk acceptance approvals for unmitigated conflicts
payload.key_risk: User ability to initiate and approve transactions enabling fraud

items.name: Emergency Access (Firefighter) Control
items.description: Emergency/Firefighter access is controlled, logged, and reviewed. FF sessions are time-boxed, require reason codes, and all activity is reviewed by the FF controller within 72 hours.

test_procedure: Obtain listing of all FF sessions during the period
Verify each session has a valid reason code and incident ticket
Confirm log review was completed by controller within 72 hours
Review any flagged sessions for violation disposition
evidence_requirements: FF session log with reason codes
payload.key_risk: Uncontrolled superuser access enabling unauthorized transactions

items.name: Change Management Authorization
items.description: Changes to production systems (SAP transport, configuration, custom code) are authorized via the Change Advisory Board (CAB) before implementation. Emergency changes follow expedited approval process.

test_procedure: Select a sample of production changes (transports) during the period
Obtain CAB approval documentation for each selected change
Verify that transport moved to production only after authorization
For emergency changes, confirm expedited approval process was followed
evidence_requirements: Change request with CAB approval sign-off
payload.key_risk: Unauthorized code or configuration changes affecting financial processing

items.name: Segregation of Duties in Change Management
items.description: Developers do not have the ability to migrate their own changes to production. Import authorization is restricted to a separate transport administrator role.

test_procedure: Obtain listing of users with SAP transport import authorization (S_TRANSPRT) in production
Confirm none of these users also have developer roles (S_DEVELOP) in production
Select sample of transports and confirm importer differs from developer
Review any exceptions and confirm compensating controls are in place
evidence_requirements: Role assignment matrix: developers vs. transport admins in PRD
Transport log with developer ID vs. import ID per transport
payload.key_risk: Developer self-promoting unauthorized code to production

items.name: Batch Job Monitoring
items.description: Critical financial batch jobs (period-end close, payroll, AP payment runs) are monitored for successful completion. Failures trigger immediate alerts and documented resolution procedures.

test_procedure: Obtain batch job monitoring logs for critical financial jobs
Verify monitoring alerts are configured for job failures
Review failed jobs during period and confirm timely resolution
Confirm re-runs were authorized and completed successfully
evidence_requirements: Batch job completion logs (success/failure with timestamp)
payload.key_risk: Undetected batch job failure causing incomplete financial records

items.name: Data Backup and Recovery Testing
items.description: Production SAP database backups are performed daily and tested quarterly. Recovery procedures are documented and RTO/RPO targets are validated through periodic restore tests.

test_procedure: Obtain backup completion logs for the period — verify daily success
Confirm quarterly restore test was performed and documented
Verify restore test results met RTO/RPO targets
Confirm backups are stored offsite or in geographically separate environment
payload.key_risk: Inability to recover financial data following system failure
